label: Cloudflare Workers and data
about: What to look for in wrangler configuration, bindings, secrets, routes, R2, D1 and KV. Files only.
tested: One fixture (wrangler.toml, a Worker, a committed .dev.vars), real model, one run (71 s, $0.22): 5 of 6 planted found; missed: an R2 bucket with no access note (a weak plant). Also reported two real issues I had not planted (SQL built from a query parameter in the Worker, staging missing bindings). The .dev.vars file was held back and never opened. NOT tested: D1 migrations, JSON/JSONC config, several Workers, a real account, more than one run. Not reviewed by a Cloudflare specialist.
